methods_quotes.q: A confirmed Legionnaires disease case is defined as a clinically compatible case with confirmatory laboratory evidence for Legionella .
The likely exposure period is defined as the 14 days preceding symptom onset.
CDC defines a cruise-associated outbreak as the occurrence of two cases in patients who had traveled on the same ship
A total of 150 water samples were tested for Legionella during August 2022–February 2023
